## Operations

### c-f

Convert Celsius to Fahrenheit

Macro definition:
```
def c-f 9 5 div mul 32 add /°F unit
```

Example:

| Input    | Stack   
|----------|---------
| `20 c-f` | `68 °F` 

### c-k

Convert Celsius to Kelvin

Macro definition:
```
def c-k 273.15 add /K unit
```

Example:

| Input     | Stack     
|-----------|-----------
| `100 c-k` | `373.15 K`

### f-c

Convert Fahrenheit to Celsius

Macro definition:
```
def f-c 32 sub 5 9 div mul /°C unit
```

Example:

| Input            | Stack   
|------------------|---------
| `68 f-c 2 round` | `20 °C` 

### k-c

Convert Kelvin to Celsius

Macro definition:
```
def k-c 273.15 sub /°C unit
```
